name: Kartra
summary: All-in-one platform for selling online: landing pages, email automation, funnels, memberships and checkout in one tool — no plugins to stitch together.
best_for: creators and coaches who want funnels, email, checkout, memberships and scheduling under one roof instead of five subscriptions
skip_if: you only need one of those pieces — a dedicated tool does that piece better and cheaper than an all-in-one; or you want to run webinars inside it: Kartra's own help centre says that from 1 November 2026 you can no longer create or edit webinars (read 28 September 2026), and Kartra told its affiliates the feature is removed entirely on 1 December 2026 — even though the pricing page still names Webinars as a Starter feature
honest_knock: If your core need is polished course delivery, Kajabi's creator features are stronger; Kartra wins on all-in-one breadth, not course depth.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-05 and again 2026-09-30 on their own pricing page) Four tiers, monthly against yearly: Essentials $59 / $52, Starter $119 / $99, Growth $229 / $189 and Professional $549 / $429, with yearly billing advertised as saving up to 22% and a 14-day trial. The tier names moved since our August reading — the $119 plan is now called Starter and the $229 plan Growth — while every amount stayed the same. The line that changes the arithmetic and is missing from most summaries: Essentials charges a 5% transaction fee on your sales, and the tiers above it charge 0%. On $10,000 a month of sales that fee is $500, which makes the $60 step from Essentials to Starter trivially worth taking. Contacts are capped at 500, 2,500, 12,500 and 25,000 across the four tiers; Essentials sends 10,000 emails and texts a month against unlimited above it and includes 1 custom domain. Kartra never blocks new leads: it upgrades you automatically to the tier that fits and charges a mid-cycle reconciliation fee for the move — two answers above that one, the same FAQ says a Kartra subscription is flat-rate and there are never any extra fees. On 30 September 2026 all eight amounts were unchanged, and the page now opens with a 30-day money-back guarantee and cancel-anytime line above the plan toggle.
